selection.quantile: Pinned BBA percentile implementation; with16 samples the p95 is the maximum.
selection.rule: Largest tested concurrency with request p95 <=10s; otherwise the smallest tested concurrency, explicitly not SLO-qualified.
selection.timing_scope: Pilot HTTP elapsed after acquiring its closed-loop concurrency semaphore; not open-loop end-to-end capacity.

protocol.inference: Three paired trace repetitions per replica/load condition; exploratory only. No request pooling or confirmatory library claim.
protocol.native_uncertainty: Retain observed client outcomes; censor native resource lifetime.
protocol.primary_endpoint: correct client response within10s / all scheduled measurement arrivals
